arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

v = VersionInfo.parse('1.2.3-alpha.1+build.5')

# Test to_tuple
t = v.to_tuple()
print('to_tuple:', t)
assert t == (1, 2, 3, 'alpha.1', 'build.5'), 'to_tuple failed'

# Test to_dict
d = v.to_dict()
print('to_dict:', d)
assert d == {'major': 1, 'minor': 2, 'patch': 3, 'prerelease': 'alpha.1', 'build': 'build.5'}, 'to_dict failed'

# Test __getitem__
assert v[0] == 1
assert v[1] == 2
assert v[2] == 3
assert v[3] == 'alpha.1'
assert v[4] == 'build.5'

# Negative indices
assert v[-1] == 'build.5'
assert v[-2] == 'alpha.1'
assert v[-3] == 3
assert v[-4] == 2
assert v[-5] == 1

# Slices
assert v[1:3] == (2, 3)
assert v[:2] == (1, 2)
assert v[3:] == ('alpha.1', 'build.5')
assert v[::2] == (1, 3, 'build.5')

# Test that existing functionality still works
assert v.major == 1
assert v.minor == 2
assert v.patch == 3
assert v.prerelease == 'alpha.1'
assert v.build == 'build.5'

print('All tests passed!')
"
